name: UNCTAD Publications

download.notes: Publication cards link to record pages under /publication/{slug}. The official PDF is served from https://unctad.org/system/files/official-document/{code}_en.pdf and is linked on the record page. Two-step crawl (listing/search -> record -> PDF) required.

methodologyMarkdown:
## Overview
UNCTAD (UN Trade and Development) runs a Drupal-based publications catalog. Content is server-rendered, but the site sits behind a strict CDN/WAF (Cloudflare) that returns HTTP 403 to non-browser User-Agents. Automated clients must present a realistic browser User-Agent and honor cookies to retrieve pages.

## Search
A dedicated search endpoint exists: /search?keyword={query}&type=publication, which restricts results to publications. The browse listing lives at /publications.

## Filters
The search endpoint accepts a type=publication filter; additional facets appear as URL parameters on the listing. No formal filter schema is published, so these are treated as opaque URL params.

## Download
Official PDFs follow a highly regular pattern: https://unctad.org/system/files/official-document/{symbol}_en.pdf (e.g. wir2024_en.pdf, tdr2024_en.pdf). These links are exposed on each publication record page, enabling reliable direct download once the record is fetched.

## Metadata & Enrichment
Record pages carry title, date, document symbol and abstract in server-rendered HTML. No JSON/REST API is available, so enrichment is HTML-based.

## Limitations
HONEST: WebFetch returned 403 (WAF blocking the crawler User-Agent), not because the page is a JS SPA. The HTML is server-rendered and scrapable with a proper browser User-Agent. Without one, no links are retrievable. Pagination uses ?page=N.
probeNotes: WebFetch of /publications returned HTTP 403 (Cloudflare/WAF blocking bot UA). Search corroborated via WebSearch: server-rendered Drupal, PDF pattern /system/files/official-document/{symbol}_en.pdf confirmed across many docs (wir2024, tdr2024, tdstat48). Search endpoint /search?keyword=&type=publication documented on site.
